# Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Alec Radford, Jeffrey Wu, Rewon Child, David Luan, Dario Amodei, Ilya Sutskever  
**Year:** 2019  
**Journal:** OpenAI Blog  
**DOI:** [10.48550/arXiv.1911.02116](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.1911.02116)  
**Publisher:** [https://cdn.openai.com/better-language-models/language_models_are_unsupervised_multitask_learners.pdf](https://cdn.openai.com/better-language-models/language_models_are_unsupervised_multitask_learners.pdf)

**Keywords:** gpt-2, language model, zero-shot

## Abstract

We demonstrate that language models begin to learn these tasks without any explicit supervision when trained on a new dataset of millions of webpages called WebText.
